find: pooledThin: wallCells > 0 ? thinCells / wallCells : read.length ? 0 : NaN,
replace: pooledThin: read.length ? read.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.thin, 0) / read.length : NaN,
why: The pooled thin share becomes the mean of the per-board shares, which weighs a small board's walls as heavily as a large one's. Issue #1065 reports it beside the shipped 96 of 1,410 wall cells (6.8%), a ratio of cell sums; the mean over the 9 shipped boards is 0.0733, so the two figures would not compare.
